'''Ljubisa Dragi Rosanda Kocinac''' (born in [[Serbia]] in January 1947) is a mathematician and currently a Professor Emeritus at the [[University of Niš]], [[Serbia]].

== Biography ==
He completed his PhD,<ref name=phd>{{MathGenealogy|id=53921}}</ref> focused on [[cardinal function]]s, at the [[University of Belgrade]] in 1983, under the supervision of [[Đuro Kurepa]]. Kocinac has published over 160 papers and four books in [[topology]], [[real analysis]] and [[field of sets|fields of sets]].<ref name=publications>{{ResearchGate|Ljubisa_Kocinac}}</ref><ref name=info>{{cite journal|first=Boaz|last= Tsaban|authorlink=Boaz Tsaban|title=The mathematics of Ljubiša D. R. Kočinac|journal=[[Topology and its Applications]] |volume=160 |year=2013|issue= 18|pages= 2234–2242| doi=10.1016/j.topol.2013.07.020| mr=3120640|doi-access=}}</ref>

He has actively promoted research on [[selection principle]]s, as a fruitful collaborator and as an organizer of the first conferences in a series of international workshops titled ''Coverings, Selections and Games in Topology''. The fourth of this series, held in [[Caserta]], Italy, in June 2012 was dedicated to him on the occasion of his sixty-fifth birthday.<ref name="info"/>

His research interests include aspects of topology, especially [[selection principle]]s, [[topological game]]s and [[cover (topology)|coverings]] of topological spaces, and mathematical analysis. In particular, he introduced star [[selection principle]]s. He is also known for his wit. When asked "Would you like some wine?", Kočinac replied "Only if you insist. (Pause) Please insist.".<ref name=info /><ref>https://u.cs.biu.ac.il/~tsaban/spmc12/Kocinac.html</ref>
